newsitem.title: CANADA: Inco sees growth in nickel output, supply.
newsitem.headline: Inco sees growth in nickel output, supply.

text.p: Inco Ltd on Monday forecast a production level of 430 million pounds of nickel next year, up from this year's 415 million pounds, and an overall output growth rate of 86 percent by the next century.
"We want to remain the world's leading nickel producer in a growing nickel market," Inco chairman and chief executive Mike Sopko said in a speech to media and analysts.

Inco estimated the world nickel supply would grow in 1997 to one million tons, with world nickel demand growing to 1,025,000 tons. This year, nickel supply and demand were in balance at 960,000 tons, Inco said.
